body: Meet Genie 4, Google DeepMind’s most realistic and interactive world model yet. Built on our Gemini models, Genie 4 lets you step inside dynamic worlds in real time, steer scenes on the fly with natural language, and watch what happens next: how the world responds, how it sounds, and how the people in it move, react, and speak. We have started rolling out Genie 4 as a research preview for trusted testers, and it's coming soon to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. All Genie 4 recordings in this video show real-time interactions from Genie 4, where users use standard keyboard controls for navigation and camera control, and text prompts to steer the scene as it evolves. Learn more: https://deepmind.google/blog/genie-4-a-new-generation-of-world-simulation Join the waitlist for Project Genie: https://forms.gle/WQnSNEM3omF7Uruu7 ___ Subscribe to our channel https://www.youtube.com/@googledeepmind Find us on X https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind Follow us on Instagram https://instagram.com/googledeepmind Add us on Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepmind/
ar_body:
قدمت Google DeepMind نموذج Genie 4 لمحاكاة العوالم، المبني على نماذج Gemini.

• يدخل المستخدم عوالم ديناميكية في الزمن الحقيقي ويوجّه المشهد بلغة طبيعية.
• يستجيب العالم صوتيًا وحركيًا، ويتحرك الأشخاص ويتحدثون.
• يُطرح كمعاينة بحثية للمختبِرين الموثوقين، وقريبًا لمشتركي Google AI Ultra في Project Genie وشركاء الوصول المبكر لـ Gemini API وAI Studio.

خطوة مهمة في نماذج العالم التفاعلية.
